title: CB-FedSelect: Reproducibility Artifacts for Communication-Budgeted Pre-Upload Client Selection for Federated Intrusion Detection
description: Versioned code, manifests, processed metadata, seed-level results, bounded robustness analyses, corrected client-group privacy evidence, operational-prevalence analyses, CICIDS2017 deterministic audit, and validation records for CB-FedSelect. Raw third-party datasets are not redistributed.
